The minimum is 6068, attained at P = C.

Let f(P) = AP + 2BP + 3CP. Since 1 + 2 = 3, the weight on C is as large as the other two weights combined.

At P = C, the term 3CP has a "corner" with subgradient of length at most 3 in every direction. The remaining terms AP + 2BP are smooth at C, with gradient e_A + 2e_B, where e_A and e_B are the unit vectors from C toward A and B. Its length satisfies |e_A + 2e_B| ≤ |e_A| + 2|e_B| = 3. So the corner term dominates the gradient of the other terms, and since f is convex, P = C is the global minimum.

The value there is

f(C) = AC + 2·BC = 2022 + 2·2023 = 6068.

ANSWER: 6068
